say:0:1560214001:0.text: A giant golem! It's been hiding here, absorbing all the energy.
say:0:1560214001:0.source_cn: 巨型魔偶！原来是它躲在这里吸收能量。

say:1:1560214002:0.text: Chippy's knight-sense says this go-lamb is a tough one!
say:1:1560214002:0.source_cn: 可恶，骑士的直觉告诉满满……这将是一场苦战！

say:2:1560214003:0.text: Magister, we should save our energy and be careful.
say:2:1560214003:0.source_cn: 的确。主人，我们先保存体力，小心为上吧。
say:2:1560214003:0.male: Magister, we should save our energy and be careful.
say:2:1560214003:0.female: Magister, we should save our energy and be careful.

say:3:1560214004:0.text: Don't worry. I know my limits.
say:3:1560214004:0.male: Don't worry. I know my limits.
say:3:1560214004:0.female: Don't worry. I know my limits.
